text: I think UberX is currently not operating in accordance with the law, which makes me feel there’s a risk when I ride.

text: I think UberX currently can’t provide accident insurance for passengers, which makes me feel unprotected.

text: I think drivers should be vetted, passenger protections and drivers’ rights should both be taken into account, and above all, safety comes first.

original_text: 我有以加價計費搭乘過 Uber

text: I think that although UberX is said to serve the public, if you factor in the costs of legally paying taxes and insurance, its business model wouldn’t be able to continue operating.
original_text: 我覺得 UberX 雖然說是為了服務大眾，但如果加上合法納稅、保險的成本，它的商業模式就無法營運下去。

text: I think that as public transportation has become more widespread, the share of taxis running empty has kept climbing, and opening up private cars to carry passengers won’t expand demand—it will only make it harder for taxis to stay in business.

original_text: 我覺得任何的創新服務以達營利目的的確是社會進步的重要過程，但必須完全在法律的規範下合法經營，才能避免因非法營運而產生社會公平及社會安全等問題．

text: I think Uber is a new service that benefits both passengers and drivers.
original_text: 我覺得UBER是個讓乘客與司機雙方都能受益的新服務。

text: I think using online tools (such as apps) to hail a ride can reduce the likelihood of drivers deliberately taking detours.

original_text: Uber 是境外公司，我認為 Uebr 有責任針對在台灣繳稅的問題提出足以說服台灣社會的因應方式。

text: I think the government should establish fair regulatory rules for the transportation industry, rather than protecting specific vested interests.

text: I think that even if UberX drivers do not have professional driver’s licenses or obvious identifying markings on their vehicles, I still feel safe because every trip is recorded.
original_text:
我覺得即使Uber X沒有職業駕照或車體有明顯標示以辨識，但因其每趟行程皆有行程紀錄，也感到安全
。

text: I think UberX is usually cheaper than taxis in terms of fares, and on average you can save about the price of a boxed lunch.
original_text: 我覺得UberX在計費上通常較計程車便宜，平均都能省下一個便當的錢。

text: I think Uber should pay the taxes it owes to the government, and there is no need for excessive government intervention—let Uber and taxis compete freely; consumers have the right to choose: if they feel Uber is unsafe or lacks safeguards, they can just take a taxi instead, and if that is the prevailing public view, then Uber will naturally be eliminated by market forces, so why does the government need to intervene so much?

text: I think UberX’s existing mechanisms for safeguarding passengers’ rights are already sufficient, and allowing it to operate would give the public another convenient transportation option.

text: I think the government should be able, by confronting the challenge posed by Uber, to simultaneously improve the regulatory and rating systems for taxis, so that taxi drivers and passengers can also enjoy service quality like Uber’s.

text: I think taking a taxi is a risky thing, because the quality of the vehicles is inconsistent, and so is the quality of the drivers.

original_text: 我有用過 Uber 叫車。

text: I think Uber should pay taxes to the government where it operates.
original_text: 我覺得 Uber 應該向營業地的政府納稅。

text: I think all drivers who carry passengers should be covered by accident insurance.
original_text: 我覺得載客的司機都應該保意外險。

text: I think vehicles carrying passengers should have clear signage.
original_text: 我覺得載客的車子上應該要有明確標示。

text: I think the Ministry of Transportation and Communications is responsible for proactively cracking down on white-plate cars.
original_text: 我覺得主動取締白牌車是交通部的責任。

text: I think drivers should be allowed to accept dispatches from multiple companies at the same time.
original_text: 我覺得應該開放司機同時接受多家派遣。

text: I think the Uber platform’s dispute-resolution records should be reported to the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
original_text: 我覺得 Uber 平台的爭端解決紀錄應呈報給交通部。

text: I have used Uber outside Taiwan.
original_text: 我有在台灣以外的地方叫過 Uber

text: I think taxi bodies must be painted yellow so that they are a different color from other vehicles.
original_text: 我覺得計程車身一定要塗裝成黃色的，和其他車輛顏色不同。

text: I have a driver’s license for small cars.
original_text: 我有小型車駕駛執照。

text: I have a commercial driver’s license.
original_text: 我有職業駕照。

text: I think UberX private vehicles should have automobile passenger liability insurance when transporting passengers.
original_text: 我覺得 UberX 自用車載客時，應該要投保汽車乘客責任險。

text: Uber is labor dispatch, like bus company employees, and belongs to the service industry.
original_text: Uber 是人力派遣，就像客運僱員，屬於服務業。

text: I think UberX’s approach to managing driver qualifications is not rigorous enough.
original_text: 我認為 UberX 對司機資格的管理方式不夠嚴謹。

text: I think the concept of a carpool-like arrangement where the driver charges the riders is feasible.
original_text: 我覺得類似共乘，但由開車的人向共乘者收費的概念，是可行的。

text: I think the law only needs to set a minimum standard that protects passengers, drivers, and other road users, and leave everything else to the market to decide.
original_text: 我覺得法律僅須訂定一個能保護乘客、司機其他用路人的最低標準，其他應交由市場機制來決定。

text: I think the current quality of taxi services is uneven, and this is related to the market not providing a sufficiently fair competitive environment.
original_text: 我覺得現在的計程車服務品質參差不齊，跟市場未提供足夠的公平競爭環境有關。

text: With Uber, you might have the chance to ride in high-end models (e.g., Audi, BMW, Benz, etc.), whereas taxis are mostly domestically produced cars, so the experience feels novel in a different way.
original_text: Uber有機會搭乘高級車款(Ex.Audi.BMW.Benz.....etc.)，計程車多半為國產車，有著不同的新鮮感。

text: I think Uber is a business model that can create flexible employment opportunities.
original_text: 我認為，UBER 是一個可以創造彈性就業機會的商業模式。

text: I think the current regulations governing commercial passenger vehicles are very unfriendly to the sharing economy. The law should be amended as soon as possible; that would be more environmentally friendly.
original_text: 我覺得目前管理職業客車的法規對分享經濟很不友善。應該要盡速修法，比較環保。

text: I think Uber is a sharing-platform model rather than an employment-based one. Uber oversees the partner drivers and passengers on the platform from the perspective of a platform manager.
original_text: 我覺得UBER是一個共享平台的概念，而非僱員的概念。UBER是以一個平台管理者的角度來監督在平台上的合作司機及乘客

text: I think the existing vetting process cannot guarantee the service quality of taxi drivers.
original_text: 我覺得既有的資格審查，無法保證計程車司機的服務品質

text: I think UberX should be held to the same standard as taxis and display the registration certificate, license, and the driver’s full information in a clearly visible location inside the vehicle.
original_text: 我覺得 UberX 應比照計程車，將登記證、執照、駕駛完整資訊擺設於車內明顯可見之處。

text: I support legalizing Uber, giving consumers one more choice, giving taxi operators greater incentives for healthy competition, and further opening up multiple avenues for part-time work.
original_text: 我贊成uber合法化，讓消費者多一個選擇，讓計程車業者多一份良性競爭的動力，更讓兼職管道多方面開放。

text: I think, in terms of UberX pricing, fares should be higher at night; we shouldn’t keep prices low just for passengers if that makes it unsustainable for drivers and leads to fewer vehicles on the road.
original_text: 我覺得UberX在計費上，晚上應該費用能提高，不能以低價只為了乘客，卻讓司機無力持續，造成車輛數減少。

text: I think Uber and the government-established ride-sharing network are both matching platforms and have nothing to do with the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
original_text: 我覺得UBER跟政府成立的共乘網 都是媒合平臺 都與交通部無關

text: Setting aside the legal aspect, Uber has better matching efficiency, while taxis have better distance efficiency.
original_text: 不管法律層面前提下，uber的媒合效益比較好，計程車的距離效益比較好
